order: budget,scenario,variant; rotate first variant by budget index
success: All eight independently summed segments match; no unknown usage or outstanding reservation; partial stays partial.
denialReview: Review every denial against required/optional status, complete-request estimate, original global/class availability, accounting completeness, cancellation, deadline and concurrency. A required request fitting all hard boundaries but stopped by soft policy is a candidate false denial, retained for review.
limitations: Controlled provider and synthetic usage; not an LLM quality or currency-cost experiment.
No sandbox is invoked by this policy/ledger benchmark.
The frozen charging evaluation suite and its historical results are independent.
